title: game/biomes.json
description: The biomes (B01): ordered rows, the first whose when holds wins, and the last has no when. Loaded by BiomeData (Vocaterra.Game.Core); GameDataValidator checks the values (ids unique, ranges ordered, a final catch-all row, block names and tree species known).

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

temperature.description: How far, in thousandths, a column's temperature is jittered either way before the rows are tried.

when.description: What a column must satisfy. Absent on the last row, which catches every column.

water.description: True for columns whose ground is below the sea, false for land.

top.description: The block name of the top layer of the ground.

filler.description: The block name of the layers under it.

underwater.description: The block name of the top layer under water, when it differs from top.

snowCap.description: Snow covers the ground where the surface temperature is below the snow threshold of world.json.

surfaceStrategy.description: The name of the code strategy that shapes this biome's own ground (never a biome id); plain when absent. It fades out at the biome's border.

decorStrategy.description: The name of the code strategy that dresses this biome's ground with plants; undergrowth (the decor blocks, sown by noise) when absent.

baseTemperature.description: An optional base temperature in thousandths, for the temperature system to come.

density.description: The percent of a chunk's 4 x 4 cells that hold a tree.

crown.description: A crown shape the code builds; the species' own when absent.

density.description: The thousandths of the columns that hold a plant.

blocks.description: Block name to a positive whole-number weight.
